name: echo
description: Echo expert: repeats the ticket it is given, nothing else.

display_description.en: Reads the ticket named in its task, echoes it through one tool, and returns the echoed value.
display_description.zh: 从任务里读出工单号，调用回声工具原样返回，并把回声值作为最小产物交回给调用方核对。

quick_inputs.en: echo the ticket in this task
quick_inputs.zh: 回声本任务里的工单号

display_description.en: Echoes a ticket string back to the caller.
display_description.zh: 把传入的工单号原样回声给调用方。

display_description.en: Pins the echoed ticket to the one named in the task.
display_description.zh: 把回声的工单号锁定为任务里给出的那一个。
